rows.text: PIB's profile released on 16 March 1998 says Vajpayee has been invited by the President, K. R. Narayanan, to form the next government and will be sworn in on 19 March 1998.

locator.date_basis: PIB archive file l0398/PIBR160398 (16 March 1998); the page prints no date

rows.text: The same profile says that in 1996 he was sworn in as Prime Minister, an office he held from May 16 to May 31, 1996.
